lead: `nvs-stdlib`'s `socket_ping_keeps_a_quiet_live_peer_open` fails under a full `bun nv verify` and passes alone.
body: The case asserts that a quiet peer stays open, against a socket whose `idle` bound is 200 ms of wall clock, so the rest of the test binaries running beside it is enough to starve the ping and the `receive` throws `Timeout` instead. Re-run the gate once before believing that failure — `nv verify` tells you itself that the binary passed alone — and if it is the only red, it is not yours to fix inside an unrelated group.
